text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Long time no see, Sensei.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Hey. Welcome back, Ikuno-kun.
How does it feel to breathe your hometown air after so long?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"There really is nothing quite as relaxing as this. I'm thinking of
going on a cycling trip at least once while I'm back home."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great!
By all means, please take your time and make yourself at home.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Still, your performance last year was truly splendid.
The Hanshin JF was a fantastic race."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
This is all thanks to your teachings, Sensei.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha.
I am deeply honored to hear you say so, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
It is all the result of your and your Trainer's hard work.
...It seems you have found yourself a fine mentor.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
They are truly a reliable person.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text: —I'm sure Ikuno-kun is well aware, but your upcoming races will only become more and more punishing.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
In recent racing scenes, there's been a noticeable trend:
the more popular an Umamusume is, the more prone she is to injury.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
You've brilliantly become a first-rate Umamusume, after all.
That is all the more reason why you must be careful.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
It might be a little overbearing of me, but I
want you to be able to keep running safely.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Meddlesome?! Not at all!
I will take it to heart.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...My goal this year is to safely
complete the Tiara route
and produce solid results.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Though it will be an extremely harsh road ahead...
I believe that as long as I'm with you, Trainer,
we will surely accomplish it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm sure you and the others can do it, Ikuno-kun.
Right now, along with your iron will, you have—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text: Because I can see an unbreakable "trust" between them.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(...It feels like it's been
quite a while since I last came here.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (If I told my past self that I ran in a GⅠ, I wonder what kind of face she'd make—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ……『IRON WILL』。

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text: “—Please state your business.”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me your thoughts
on me running in all three legs
of the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"Entering all the Triple Tiara races
is considered to carry a high level of risk."

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text: "‘Considering recent trends in the relevant race, there is a possibility that the physical strain on your body may exceed acceptable thresholds.’"

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"This will increase the probability of serious injury.
If that happens, it may affect your racing career.
Would you like to review your race schedule?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I will not revise the plan.
I shall mitigate the risk by improving my own data.

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"‘Understood.
I will incorporate this into the proposal strategy.’"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (I will definitely become stronger. Strong enough to satisfy even this 'IRON WILL.')
Welcoming Ikuno Dictus's Classic Class year, as we were looking back on last year's races—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year.
I look forward to working with you again this year.
choice_data_list: Happy New Year. How was your trip home?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to refresh myself.
Here is a souvenir for you.
choice_data_list: Thanks so much for going out of your way...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Also, the teacher said,
"Please give my regards to your Trainer."
When Ikuno Dictus refers to "Teacher," she means the person who taught her maintenance and management.

To her, they were a mentor—
someone who had guided her onto the path
that led to the world of racing.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It seems the teacher is also looking forward
to our challenge in the Classic class.
choice_data_list: We definitely have to live up to that.
You've definitely got to live up to that, then.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
choice_data_list: Need to talk?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to visiting home,
my motivation right now is exceedingly high—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Simply put, I am feeling a bit restless.
Therefore, I would like to seek your counsel on how best to channel this state."

Since that was the case, what came to mind
for making good use of Ikuno Dictus's time after this was—
choice_data_list: Training is the right call here after all.
Shall we have a lunch meeting?
How about we look back at last year's races?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"That truly is the classic approach, isn't it?
I'll go change right away."

She seems exceptionally motivated.
As I start getting ready for training—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for waiting.
choice_data_list: Whoa, that was fast!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I anticipated something like this might happen,
so I prepared a change of clothes
ready to go."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Now, shall we go?
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah!
Y-Yeah!

text_block_list.text:
I wondered what kind of preparation allows someone
to change so quickly, but not wanting to keep them waiting,
I hurried to get ready myself.
—And so, I dedicated myself to training alongside Ikuno Dictus, who was full of motivation right from the start of the year.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's almost lunchtime, isn't it?
Indeed, that sounds like perfect timing.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, did you know the academy cafeteria
has a New Year's limited menu?
Since we're here, shall we go check it out?
choice_data_list: Sounds good. Let's definitely go.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Now then, what's this year's limited menu—
choice_data_list: That's the "Good Fortune! First Sunrise Burger."

text_block_list.text: "I spotted a photo displayed in the cafeteria of a hearty burger with a giant fried egg peeking out from the buns."
choice_data_list: That sure looks delicious.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we go with this one, then?

And so, the two of them ordered the First Sunrise Burger
and took their seats, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
First, smash it down...
No, if I do that, the yolk might spill...
In that case, if I shift where I grip it once...—
choice_data_list: I-Ikuno...?

text_block_list.text: She seems to be deep in thought, staring intently at the hamburger with a very serious look on her face...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ha—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. I was lost in thought for a moment.
............Well then, shall we dig in?
choice_data_list: —Hold on!

text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus is clearly acting strange.
Could she be feeling unwell?
To clear up my unease, I ask her about it—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
......I am so sorry.
I caused you needless worry.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My physical condition is fine.
It's just, um...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I am quite clumsy at it.
At eating hamburgers, that is.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, well...
things keep dropping from my grip,
and it just hasn't been going smoothly.

She is uncharacteristically evasive.
It seems this really isn't her strong suit.
choice_data_list: Then, shall we use a fork and knife?

text_block_list.text:
I saw someone eat a huge hamburger like that on TV.
If I do the same, surely the fillings won't fall out.
choice_data_list: Let me show you how it's done! Like this—hyah!

text_block_list.text: (Slip, plop)

......Did I position the fork wrong?
The bun slipped, and the force made the filling slide right out the side......
choice_data_list: ...I might not be very good at it either.
...I might not be very good at it either.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu—
choice_data_list: Haha—

text_block_list.text: Afterward, after facing all sorts of struggles, Ikuno Dictus and I ate our hamburgers with smiles on our faces—
It turned into a lunch meeting that left behind a nice little memory.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Come to think of it, Trainer, you were originally doing your review work here, weren't you?"
choice_data_list: It'll also double as research on our rivals for the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Then by all means, please let me join you.
I would like to hear Trainer-san's
current thoughts on the matter.

And so, Ikuno Dictus and I began
reviewing last year's races together—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
――Her mid-race breakthrough power is terrifying.
I feel that the moment we ease up on our positioning,
she has the skill to cut right through.
choice_data_list: If she's in the rear, instead of the inside, on the outside—

text_block_list.text: The analysis grew more heated than expected—
...By the time it ended, the sun was already beginning to set.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for your hard work.
Thanks to you, we had a very meaningful review.
choice_data_list: No, no, the pleasure's all mine— Ow, ow, ow, ow...!

text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because I've been doing so much desk work lately, but my shoulders were stiff as a board...!
How utterly pathetic of me...――

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Are your muscles stiff?
I heard quite a loud crack just now...
choice_data_list: I'm embarrassed to say...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fumu――

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
If you don't mind, may I touch around your shoulders for a moment?
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It is time for 'Maintenance.'

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I see. As expected, you're a bit stiff.
Excuse me once more.

Saying so, Ikuno Dictus began
massaging around my shoulders...

I marvel inwardly at their skill.
I can feel all the stiffness melting away...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“—How was it?
I hope that helped relieve some of it.”
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, I'm feeling a whole lot better...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to hear that. However, this massage was merely first aid, so I strongly recommend visiting a chiropractor.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Though I suppose you would know best about that, Trainer, with your expertise and all.
choice_data_list: ...I've reflected on what I did.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufuâ
Like 'a doctor who neglects their own health,'
perhaps it's 'a Trainer who...'?
...Those words hit a little too close to home.
"And so, after experiencing Ikuno Dictus's 'maintenance' firsthand, our New Year's reflection came to an end—"
